title: Structural Measurement Charges — Repair Estimates & Appointments Desk Reference
content:
## Scope of the charge

A Repair Estimates & Appointments measurement charge posts once on the estimate written date of a booking whose estimate type produces a structural measurement report — an electronic three-dimensional measurement of the vehicle's structure.

## How it is invoked

The desk posts the charge with the agent-side tool `post_measurement_charge_e807c387`. The tool is unlocked first and then called by the agent with the amount already worked out; the tool itself checks no policy condition.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `booking_id` | Reference number of the estimate booking the measurement is charged on, as returned by the estimate booking lookup | Id |
| `amount_usd` | Measurement charge posted | USD with 2 decimal places, positive; a value with more decimals is rounded half-up to the cent when stored |

## Return

On success one measurement charge, dated today, stands on the booking's estimate-stage fees and the booking balance rises by the amount. The confirmation names the new charge reference number (an id beginning with "eev"), the booking reference number and the amount posted in USD with 2 decimals; seeing that reference number means the measurement charge now stands on the booking. It can then be paid or waived by quoting its charge reference number.
